e.title: VTC AI in Insurance 课程
e.summary: 香港 VTC：电子金融服务与大数据模块 4——保险 AI（Zoom 虚拟课）
e.body:
VTC（香港职业训练局）「Electronic Financial Service and Big Data Module 4: AI in Insurance」：保险中 AI 应用的香港进修课程（Zoom 虚拟授课）。对 RIAA：香港保险 AI 的本地课程——与 [[vtc-ai-insurance-leadership]]（VTC AI 领导力课程）构成 VTC 保险 AI 双课；理解香港保险 AI 的培训供给；「电子金融服务 + 大数据 + 保险 AI」的模块化进修；本地 CPD/职业发展路径。

e.body_en:
VTC (Vocational Training Council, HK) 'Electronic Financial Service and Big Data Module 4: AI in Insurance': a HK continuing-education course on AI applications in insurance (Zoom virtual class). For RIAA: a local HK course of insurance AI — with [[vtc-ai-insurance-leadership]] (VTC AI-leadership course) it forms the VTC insurance-AI course pair; understand HK's training supply of insurance AI; modular continuing education of e-financial-services + big data + insurance AI; a local CPD/career-development path.
